content.value: An isolated T – beam is composed of a flange 28 in. wide and 6 in. deep casted monolithically with a web of 10 in.width that extends 24 in. below the bottom surface of the flange to produce a beam of 30 in. total depth. Tensile reinforcement consists of six #10 bars placed in two rows at1in. vertical spacing. The centroid of the bar group is 26in. from the top of the beam. If ${ f ^ { \prime } } _ { c } = 3 0 0 \bar { 0 }$ psi and $f _ { y } = 6 0 , 0 0 0 \ \mathrm { p s i }$ what is the design moment capacity of the beam?
